answer: Our network pairs game-theoretic multi-agent auditing with topological cut verifications to isolate fraudulent clusters. Validator nodes audit suspicious clusters; if cross-boundary cut verifications fail, malicious stakes face severe stake slashing. An attacker creating an artificial meadow of identities cannot forge honest paths to the central oasis of genuine peers. Re-establishing valid cross-cluster ties forces superlinear attacker cost scaling with network size, burning their capital as swiftly as a comet across the sky.
